title: The master hands off instead of compacting
trigger: the master's context crosses the threshold (~60-70% of the window)

steps.text: After a step, the plugin sees the context is over the threshold.

check.note: onStepEnded, coordinator only, returns unless idle and tokens >= threshold, logic.ts:102-115@83a5621.

steps.text: It queues the HANDOFF prompt into the master's session.
The master rewrites its brief: purpose, happened, open, next, ruled out.

check.note: brief_write rewrites the five slots into node.body/attrs of brief:<scope> (insert first time), views.py:742-755@83a5621; also logs change.

steps.text: Seeing brief_write succeed, the plugin marks the session briefed and compacts when the turn ends. If two turns end with no brief, it compacts anyway with the old brief.

check.note: onToolDone -> briefed (logic.ts:130); onTurnEnded compacts if briefed (136) or after 2 turns still briefing (139-141)@83a5621. Hostage pin bites here.

steps.text: Inside the compaction hook, if at least 20k tokens of work since the last flush would otherwise be lost (minRawTokens), the journal saves a raw excerpt of recent turns first; a failed write is logged, not fatal.

check.note: onCompaction runs first (index.ts:89); writes precompact excerpt only if tokens - lastJournal >= minRawTokens (20000), failure logged, journal.ts:138-141@83a5621; journaling agents only.

steps.text: The plugin runs `coordlite handoff`: the old session row ends with its brief, the next opens.

check.note: session_handoff views.py:769-777@83a5621 (via __main__.py:104-105): ends open row (ended_at, ended_why, tokens_at_end, brief_node_id), opens successor (started_at).

steps.text: The CLI builds the boot packet from the store: brief, plan, lint, recent writes, journal backlog, the human's profile, the index.

check.note: boot_packet __main__.py:19-63@83a5621: brief, plan_render, store_lint, last 30 changes, journal_stats, profile_line, knowledge_index.

steps.text: The plugin replaces OpenCode's summary with the boot packet: same session id and title, so peers still reach it.

check.note: input.result = {summary: boot, tokens} logic.ts:154@83a5621; falls back to OpenCode compaction on failure (156-157).

steps.text: On the successor's first step, if the context is still over the threshold, handoffs stop for this session.

check.note: fresh set in onCompaction (logic.ts:159); first step over threshold -> phase disabled, logic.ts:106-112@83a5621, until the next compaction resets state (invariant body now says so).
